Findings that come from the history read back after an upgrade point at the right backup, and a finding can show which folders changed.

## ✨ Added

- **Compare with the backup before.** A finding about the size, file count or new data of a container, VM or folder set has a **Compare with the backup before** button. It compares the last good backup with the first affected one and lists the folders where files went away, came in or changed. When nearly all of it sits in a search index, a cache or thumbnails, it says so, because an app rebuilds such a folder by itself and excluding it keeps those rebuilds out of the backups and out of the findings.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Findings from history read back after an upgrade are dated to the backup they began on.** BombVault reads that history all at once, so a source that had already shrunk several backups earlier was dated to the newest one, and its last good backup was the one just before, which could be affected as well. The finding now starts at the first affected backup and offers the backup before it to restore. Reported in [#281](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/281).
- **A finding names the backup it began on.** The opened finding shows its first affected backup. First seen, the moment BombVault noticed, moves to the details, since after an upgrade it can be days after the backup.
